title: VIXEN native wrapper should make the requested configuration explicit
body: The required Windows Release witness first invoked tools/vixen-native.sh build, which selected the vixen-ninja Debug preset; the Release witness required manually passing build all vixen-ninja-release. Tier haiku because the wrapper can require or derive the configuration from the witness target and fail early with a located diagnostic.

title: Editor VRC1 bake parity needs a reusable d11 fixture contract
body: The requested neutral, two-material, and default-only editor-versus-undertow-author bake witness required manually reconstructing manifest/render_recipe/materials files from retained evidence and placing .utb outputs outside each input pack because the author CLI scans every pack file. The two-material comparison still reports byte differences at offsets 169 and 829. Tier luna because the fix needs a shared fixture/manifest and exact material-table ownership across VIXEN and Undertow.
